title: Reformulation-Contrastive Learning for Mixed Integer Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.00730v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixed-integer linear programs (MILP) model many real-world decision problems, motivating machine-learning methods that exploit recurring structure to accelerate MILP solving. MILPs can admit many equivalent formulations: integrality-preserving changes of variables and the addition of redundant constraints can alter their formulations while preserving the optimization problem. We leverage these reformulations as a source of self-supervision for learning general-purpose representations of MILP variables and constraints. We characterize the affine reformulations that are valid for every input instance, and distinguish re-descriptions, which leave variables unchanged, from substitutions, which transform them predictably. Building on equivariant self-supervised learning, we introduce ReMILP (reformulation-contrastive MILP representation learning), which jointly trains a graph neural network and a hypernetwork to predict how variable embedding

translated_title: 面向混合整数规划的重新表述对比学习
translated_abstract: 混合整数线性规划（MILP）对许多现实世界的决策问题进行建模，这促使人们开发机器学习方法来利用重复出现的结构以加速MILP的求解。MILP可以存在许多等价的表述形式：保持整数性的变量变换以及添加冗余约束都可以改变其表述形式，同时保持优化问题本身不变。我们利用这些重新表述作为自监督学习的来源，用于学习MILP变量和约束的通用表示。我们刻画了对每个输入实例都有效的仿射重新表述，并区分了保持变量不变的“重新描述”与以可预测方式变换变量的“替换”。基于等变自监督学习，我们提出了ReMILP（重新表述对比MILP表示学习），该方法联合训练图神经网络和超网络，以预测变量嵌入如何……
tldr: 提出ReMILP方法，利用MILP的等价重新表述（变量替换与冗余约束）作为自监督信号，通过对比学习联合训练图神经网络与超网络，学习通用的MILP变量与约束表示以加速求解。
en_tdlr: Proposes ReMILP, which exploits equivalent MILP reformulations (variable substitutions and redundant constraints) as self-supervision, jointly training a graph neural network and a hypernetwork via contrastive learning to obtain general-purpose MILP representations for faster solving.
